ipos.prose:
As of today, the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO grey market premium is ₹30 at the median of 7 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹18 and ₹45. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 90% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹118 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 25.42%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 19.78× overall — strong. The issue is open for bidding now (17-21 Sept) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (44/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 22 Sep, with listing expected 24 Sep 2026. For the SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹42.52 Cr. See also SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO subscription status and SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO allotment status. This SpectraA Technology Solutions IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

Right now the grey market is pricing the SS Retail IPO at a median premium of ₹142 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹131 to ₹145. That is ₹9 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Set against the upper price band of ₹424, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 33.49% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 108.69× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (83/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the SS Retail IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 21 Sep, with listing expected 23 Sep 2026. For the SS Retail IPO, one lot is 35 shares and the issue size is ₹500.00 Cr. See also SS Retail IPO subscription status and SS Retail IPO allotment status. This SS Retail IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

Right now the grey market is pricing the Raksan Transformers IPO at a median premium of ₹10.5 — the midpoint of 4 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹10 to ₹12. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Trackers differ by about 19% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹273 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 3.85%; treat it as expectation, not promise. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (59/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. The Raksan Transformers IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 16 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Raksan Transformers IPO allotment status. This Raksan Transformers IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.
